behavioralChecks: A peer without an episode is NO_EPISODES with no invented grade.
A harmful retry remains REGRESSION even when another target score improves.
Missing grades remain null; failed work with valid retained grades remains attributable.
Class revision, roles, unit/world binding and session window are checked before dispatch.
Scheduled admission is inclusive at start and exclusive at end. A session closing does not cancel an already-admitted episode.
Exact terminal replay uses the pinned historical snapshot and remains available after a session closes or the current class store is absent.
Historical v1 evidence stays byte-equivalent and is not retroactively assigned a class. New classless v1 execution is refused.
Changing an admitted class snapshot is refused even when a replacement digest is recomputed.
limits: Class enforcement applies to newly executed manifest-based model episodes. The inherited human lesson UI is not yet class management.
Class schedules admit explicit starts; there is no automatic scheduler, recurrence worker, attendance ledger or admission audit.
Roster IDs and editions remain declarations, not a continuing identity registry or loaded-model attestations. Old revisions are selected explicitly; enrollment revocation is not implemented.
Peers share membership, curriculum and teacher declarations. Private work is excluded from participant views; peer messaging, tutoring, shared submissions and group projects are not implemented.
CLI and HTTP are owner interfaces using the existing shared-server/desktop trust boundary, not individually authenticated learner accounts.
Prerequisite links are checked for consistency and cycles, not for mastery. Curriculum reuse is by embedded snapshot, not a separate registry.
Grades use the authored trimmed-exact-v1 key. These cases do not establish transfer, long-term retention or real-model learning; live local, Claude and OpenAI qualification remains open.
Storage remains unsigned local files. Concurrency guards are process-local, not distributed fencing or fleet scheduling.
Resource budgets, persistent learner memory, independent sealed evaluation, constructive artifact checkers and AUM training/adoption receipts remain in issues 5 through 8.
